vanilla_structure_template_hits.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the Map.computeIfAbsent call in StructureTemplateManager.get: for a ConcurrentHashMap or Guava LocalCache map (ModernFix dynamic_structure_manager's softValues cache), a non-null Map.get answer is returned without the cache lock; null (absent, collected, loading) and every other map class run the original call. 1.21.1: get unchanged, Guava 32.1.2's LocalCache paths the same as 31.1's; steps aside next to Generator Accelerator's size-bounded LocalCache (yield)

yields.name: Generator Accelerator
yields.why: Generator Accelerator (tested 1.21.1-1.6.2) replaces StructureTemplateManager's template map at the end of its constructor with CacheBuilder.newBuilder().maximumSize(256).build().asMap(). That is a Guava LocalCache like ModernFix's, so the class check would accept it, but it is size-bounded: its LRU access queue is updated differently by get and by compute, so which templates stay cached could differ. The exactness argument covers ConcurrentHashMap and the unbounded soft-values cache only, so this switch steps aside whenever that mixin is listed. Found by a scan of the other mods' mixins on the same classes for the 1.21.1 port (no crash class: the map is replaced at RETURN).
